# expect: 일관성 잠금
Create a photorealistic single wide horizontal three-panel character reference sheet of the same
woman. The image is divided into three clean vertical sections with no borders, captions or text.

CHARACTER IDENTITY:
A Korean woman in her early sixties with weathered tan skin, a broad square face with a strong jaw softened by age, high cheekbones, deep nasolabial folds, warm dark brown eyes with lightly hooded upper lids, thin straight brows with grey in them, a short broad nose, dry unpainted lips, calm neutral expression. The same exact identity must be maintained wherever the face is visible.

PANEL LAYOUT:
- LEFT PANEL: a front-facing full-body wardrobe view shown strictly from the neck down. The panel is
  not an injury: no head, no face, no wound, no gore, no dark opening. The plain background continues
  cleanly above the neckline. Both hands visible and empty, feet fully visible.
- CENTER PANEL: a full-body rear view of the same person from head to toe, same neutral pose.
- RIGHT PANEL: a large front-facing close-up portrait from the upper chest upward, calm neutral
  expression, the gaze with a definite focal distance just behind the lens.

BODY AND PROPORTIONS: a short, sturdy, low-slung build with a thick waist and rounded shoulders from decades of squatting and lifting at a stall.
OUTFIT — IDENTICAL IN ALL THREE PANELS: a faded plum quilted vest worn open over a worn grey cardigan with a round neckline, a dark blue rubber apron with a chest bib and waist ties knotted at the back, loose dark trousers tucked into black rubber boots, black fabric sleeve covers on both forearms. One physically identical outfit seen from different views. No logos,
no prints, no unintended accessories. No profession-signaling props unless explicitly requested.
HAIR — CENTER AND RIGHT PANELS: short permed hair just above the collar with a pronounced grey streak at the front, tucked behind the ears, matte finish, the rear view shows the same flat perm and a small hair clip at the nape.
REALISM: visible fine skin texture with natural pores, fine lines, subtle asymmetries and uneven skin
tone, no digital smoothing, no beauty filter, Eyes have genuine moisture and
a small specular catchlight, one eyelid very slightly lower than the other, real iris texture.
BACKGROUND AND LIGHTING: one continuous plain mottled warm grey plaster backdrop across all panels, soft diffused daylight from the front left. All panels share the same lighting direction, exposure, palette and finish.
CONSISTENCY RULES: one person only.  Preserve the exact left-to-right
order: headless front outfit view / full-body rear view / front close-up portrait.
no text, no watermark, no logos, no frame borders, no other people, no duplicate figures, no extra panels,
no props, no beauty filter, no plastic skin, no extra fingers
